sources.entry: prismantis by Nahum Litvin - Colorful, themeable Claude Code replies: tables, code, diagrams, charts and tool rows in over a dozen themes. Enhances mod development experience.

summary.one_liner: A Claude Code mod that redraws assistant replies, tool rows, tables, code, diagrams, charts and prompts in a choice of color themes.
summary.what_it_does: prismantis is a Claude Code plugin (TypeScript function hooks) that changes how replies and tool calls look in the terminal. It draws markdown tables, syntax-highlighted code blocks with copy buttons, and mermaid flowcharts, sequence/state/class/ER diagrams, pie, gantt and xychart charts as colored text art. It offers 17 color themes plus a mono option, and 20 overridable color slots. Tool calls appear as one-line rows (for example "Ran 3 commands, read 2 files") with status dots and diff cards for edits. Optional extras include LaTeX math rendered as images in kitty and Ghostty via the external RaTeX renderer, and copy buttons that put Markdown, HTML or PNG on the clipboard. Turning it off with a setting or /plugin restores Claude Code's own renderer.
use_cases: make Claude Code replies easier to read in the terminal
render mermaid diagrams and charts as text in a terminal
copy tables or code from Claude replies to Slack or docs
typeset LaTeX math inside Claude Code in kitty or Ghostty
build a custom markdown renderer for other Claude Code mods
notable: Draws mermaid diagrams and charts as colored text art instead of showing source
17 themes plus mono, switchable with /prismantis theme
Tool rows summarize calls and can be set to a quiet mode that hides read-only output
Right-to-left rendering for Hebrew and Arabic
Offers an API ($.prismantis.markdown) so other mods can draw markdown in the user's theme
caveats: LaTeX needs a separately installed RaTeX binary and draws images only in kitty and Ghostty; elsewhere formulas stay text
Requires Claude Code 2.1.287 or later; some features need 2.1.289–2.1.295
Copy-to-HTML works only in a local macOS terminal or a Linux graphical session with CopyQ; tested by hand only on macOS
Adds about 630 tokens of model-only hint text to each prompt unless diagramHints is turned off
